description: This file implements tracing utilities combining OpenTelemetry and k8s.io/utils/trace for Kubernetes components, including span creation, event addition, error recording, and context management.

classes.name: Span
classes.description: Represents a combined OpenTelemetry and k8s.io/utils/trace span for tracing operations.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Creates a new combined span using OpenTelemetry and utils/trace, returning a context with the span.

methods.name: AddEvent
methods.description: Adds an event with a name and attributes to the span.

methods.name: End
methods.description: Ends the span and logs if the duration exceeds a threshold.

methods.name: RecordError
methods.description: Records an error as an event in the span.

methods.name: SpanFromContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current span from the context.

methods.name: ContextWithSpan
methods.description: Returns a new context with the given span included.
